note: The sentence ledger of the copy WP-60 put on the site: the CTA targets, the audience strip and the wave 8 form copy (docs/wave8-contracts.md, section 9). Each sentence maps to one claim (C-nn), one existing page with a heading (path#heading), or one decision (W8-nn); a control label that states no fact about WE is marked label (seven words at most). tests/unit/wp-60/copy-ledger.test.ts enumerates the sentences from the modules, fails on one with no mapping and on a mapping with no sentence, checks each mapping with tests/unit/wp-60/sources.ts, and runs the claims denylist over all of them. The file has no fetches: it quotes no outside source. A brief's heading is a template, 'Request the brief: {label}', because the label comes from the family registry. Interface strings built at run time (the form status lines and the validation messages in src/data/forms.ts) are denylist-scanned by the form tests and need no ledger entry, the WP-43 precedent.
